scenes.say: Ever wonder why Jenkins is still the go-to tool for continuous integration and delivery in big companies?

scenes.label: Pipeline
scenes.sub: Pipelines are defined in a Jenkinsfile stored in your code repo.
scenes.say: With Jenkins, you write your pipeline steps in a Jenkinsfile right alongside your code.
A typical Jenkins pipeline has three main stages: build, test, and deploy. Each stage automates a key part of your workflow.

scenes.title: Pipeline Definition
scenes.say: Here's what a Jenkins pipeline looks like. Each stage runs a shell command for build, test, and deploy.

scenes.question: Why does deploy fail with connection refused?
scenes.right: It's often a firewall rule blocking the Jenkins agent subnet.
scenes.say: If your deploy step fails with a connection refused error, don't just blame the script. It's usually a firewall blocking Jenkins agents.
